thread.title: Microsoft Finishes Friday With Higher Market Cap Than Apple -- Market Mover

author: morningstar.com
title: Microsoft Finishes Friday With Higher Market Cap Than Apple -- Market Mover
text:
Microsoft Corp. (MSFT) finished Friday's trading with a higher market capitalization than Apple Inc. (AAPL). Apple shares closed Friday's trading down 0.54% at $178.58, and the stock had a market cap of $847.4 billion, according to FactSet. Microsoft shares finished up 0.64% at $110.89, with the stock's market cap reaching $851.2 billion, according to FactSet. Microsoft shares are up slightly after hours, rising 0.10% to $111, and Apple after hours is also up slightly, seeing a 0.07% rise to $178.70. Apple was the first U.S. company to reach $1 trillion in market value, a feat it achieved in September. (stephen.nakrosis@wsj.com)
